summary: Stale replication exchange faults name the dominant last failure phase and code across current peers

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: New exchange-stale attention reasons include the most common last failure phase/code and its peer count, using existing local exchange evidence. Current membership and a pending bootstrap sponsor define the targets; legacy peer configuration uses observed peers. Ties are deterministic. Timestamps, elapsed durations and free-form causes are excluded so repeated observations keep stable text. Fault identity, recovery, status fields and client protocol are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous fault wording; stored data is unchanged.
